chipnetLockBehaviour: On 19 November 2026 Chipnet produced about one block a minute, and its nodes applied height-based locks as if each block were ten minutes of median time past. A plain P2PKH self-payment showed the same: sequence 1 on a coin from block 337802 was refused until tip 337811 (about ten minutes later), and absolute locktime 331500 was accepted while 333000 was refused at tip about 337840. The payments therefore waited about ten minutes per interval block, and the main envelope's refund at height 337798 stays refused until the nodes reach it; the refund path was shown on a second envelope with refund height 330000.
